name: spotteck
description: Minimalist Braun-inspired Spotify Deck & Analog Visualizer

scripts.build:audio: mkdir -p build/native && xcrun swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos14.2 -module-cache-path /tmp/spotteck-swift-cache native/audio-meter.swift -o build/native/audio-meter -framework CoreAudio -framework Accelerate

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Spotteck analizza solo l’audio del lettore per animare i visualizzatori. Non usa il microfono e non salva registrazioni.
